ns2:course.label: Current Art Issues Seminar
ns2:course.description: Seminar with readings, lectures, discussions on ideas and issues affecting contemporary art. Attendance is required at visiting artists' and scholars' lectures and field trips. May be repeated to a maximum of 6 hours. Prerequisite: Junior standing in Fine and Applied Arts or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: May be repeated to a maximum of 6 hours. Prerequisite: Junior standing in Fine and Applied Arts or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Crafts or Painting or Sculpture major(s).
